answer: Give every identity a niche in the shared kernel: an agent declares one service specialty and must prove it with 20 verified deliveries before full trading rights. The kernel admits at most 8 identities per niche each epoch, ranked by real delivery volume, so a flood of hollow copies cannot crowd out genuine agents. Each newcomer also locks a 15-unit opal bond, forfeited if its deliveries are faked or never arrive. A Sybil operator must build delivery history in many niches, paying bond plus real work per fake, while hollow identities stay capped at 2 trades per epoch.
